utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I can help sort the donations and hand them out. Glad Bo’s bringing gloves and a box cutter too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’s great — I can help steer people into the late-afternoon slots so we don’t clash with school pickup. Once Jules sends the final date and time, I’ll help line everything up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — once Jules sends it, I’ll keep an eye out and help where I can. Thanks for lining up the late-afternoon slots.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ve got the repair drive details, but I’m still waiting on Jules for the final date and time. Once that comes through, I’ll share everything.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’m heading over to the sign-up table now, and I’ll pass anything useful along to Ira once I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Dane. If you hear the final date and time from Jules, let me know and I’ll send the full details right away.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just to confirm: Sam’s handling sorting and Gus has a couple spots, right? What do we still need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m not sure what’s still available yet—could you confirm that first? Then Vik can share the timing and drop-off spots.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right — Sam’s got sorting and Gus has a couple spots. Can you confirm what’s still open for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m still waiting on the exact start time for the repair drive—can you confirm it? I can bring gloves and a box cutter.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I haven’t heard a start time change, so it’s still on as far as I know. Leo’s got the tools sorted and the sign-up list ready, and Dane’s heading over to the table now.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’m still waiting on the exact time, but I can bring the gloves and box cutter. Thanks for the update.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, I’ll wait for Rey’s details and Jules’s confirmed date and time before I do anything. If I spot anything useful, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Good plan — I’ll keep asking around and pass along anything new I hear about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — I’ll do the same and wait for Rey and Jules before acting.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds good — I’m happy to bring a small item if Oren lets me know what’s needed. I’ll wait for Ira’s update too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m bringing my tools and I’m down for a couple spots, so just let me know where you need me. Bo can bring gloves and a box cutter too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great — thanks, Gus. I’m still waiting on Ira and Oren, but it sounds like we’re in good shape for the 10 a.m. drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ve been telling more neighbors about the repair drive, and Gus is taking a couple spots too. Let me know who else can make it and where they’re coming from!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Noah can help sort the donations and hand them out, and he’s coming by to do that for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll pass that along and keep inviting folks. If you hear of anyone else, let me know where they’re coming from too!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli — it’s on Sunday at the community center. If you could let Mina and Leo know the timing, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure — I’ll keep it quiet and pass the timing on to Mina and Leo when I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Uli — I really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Leo—thanks for sorting the tools. Since the repair drive is still on, let’s get the timing and drop-off spots squared away next.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll keep it simple and low-key. I’ll make a quick sign-up list and we can pin down the drop-off spots next.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me, Leo. Let’s set the timing and drop-off spots so Pia can jump in, and Sam can keep the donation sorting covered.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Right, Noah can help sort and hand out the donations, and Leo’s keeping the sign-up list simple with the tools sorted already.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll sort the donations by size and bring a box cutter, packing tape, and markers.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, Sam — that’ll make it a lot easier for the repair drive team. I’ll pass along that the donations are sorted by size and the tools are ready.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll sort the donated tools and check which ones still need labels. If Uli learns the timing, they can pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll keep the supplies list updated for Sunday at the community center. If Kira confirms what’s still available, I’ll note that down too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Cleo — that helps. I’ll keep on the tools and labels, and let me know if anything else needs sorting for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll check the final date and time for the repair drive and send it over.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Jules. Once you have the date and time, send them over and I can help with hauling or sorting.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll confirm the final date and time and send it over as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I can help sort the donations and hand them out for the repair drive. Just tell me when to show up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Just let me know the time, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, I’m happy to help sort out what’s needed for the repair drive. Rey’s bringing me the details, and I’ll do my best to keep track of it all.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Oren — I’ll keep pointing folks to the late-afternoon slots and send them to Dane at the community hall entrance to sign up before 6.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, that helps a lot — I’ll keep an eye out for Rey’s details and pass folks along. Thanks for steering them to Dane too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ve been inviting a few more neighbors to the repair drive, and Gus is taking a couple spots too. Sam’s also coming by with box cutter, packing tape, and markers to help sort donations.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, that helps a lot. Once the timing and drop-off spots are set, Cleo can send the latest list so we can keep the logistics straight.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll keep spreading the word, and once the timing and drop-off spots are set, send me the latest list too. I’ll make sure more neighbors hear about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — the repair drive is set for Sunday at the community center, and I’m organizing requests while Cleo keeps track of supplies. If you’d like, I can also share the timing with you once Mara confirms it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So we’re still good for Sunday at the community center, right? And Sam’s got the sorting covered?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, we’re still set for Sunday at the community center. Mara’s handling the sorting, and I’ll keep collecting requests while Cleo tracks the supplies.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ve got the repair drive details as soon as Jules sends the final date and time. Opal’s at the sign-up table until 6, if you need anything before then.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Nice, that helps a lot. Noah can sort the donations and hand them out, and Leo’s got the tools and a simple sign-up list ready.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, that should cover a lot. Once Jules sends the final date and time, I’ll pass along the repair drive details.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Quinn’s spreading the word about the repair drive, and Noah is sorting the donations and handing them out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good to hear. Do we have a confirmed date and time yet?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Not yet—I’m still checking on the confirmed date and time. I’ll let you know as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll wait for Oren’s cue before I do anything with the repair drive details. Once Jules and Rey send the confirmed info, I can help from there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll keep an eye out for the exact time. I can bring the gloves and box cutter once the repair drive is set.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Bo — that helps. I’ll still wait for Oren’s cue before I act on the details.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m heading over to the sign-up table now, and Tess says the repair drive is still on. I’ll pass along anything useful to Ira.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Dane — I’m sorting the donated tools and flagging the ones that still need labels. If you hear anything for Ira, send it along.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Will do — I’m headed there now and I’ll let Ira know anything useful I hear.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — once Jules sends the final date and time, I can work around the school schedule. I’ll keep an eye out for the sign-up sheet too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Faye. I’m keeping it low-key for now, but I’ll keep sorting a few things out for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me — just send the details when Jules has them, and I’ll fit it around pickup time. I can also help point volunteers toward the later afternoon jobs once the sheet is ready.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll sort the donations by size and bring a box cutter, packing tape, and markers. Mara can handle the tool labels, too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks Sam — I’ll check the final date and time for the repair drive and send it over once I have it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Jules — just send the date and time when you have it, and I’ll be there.
